lC.text:
NOTE: When importing custom notes, make sure to use the right note of the skin, and make sure to make changes to the color variable if necessary. When naming the note costumes, put the name of the note followed by either Default or Flash depending on what costume it is, then put the name of the note in the note skin variable. 

An example of how the name should look like: BlankDefault or BlankFlash
